name: memra
description: Rust + CUDA inference engine for NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell and RTX 5090. Serves safetensors and GGUF over an OpenAI-compatible API, with per-device tuned defaults and speculative decode gated byte-identical to plain decode. Hosted instance: inference.tiyuvta.ai
summaryZh: Rust + CUDA inference engine for NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell and RTX 5090. Serves safetensors and GGUF over an OpenAI-compatible API, with per-device tuned defaults and speculative decode gated byte-identical to plain decode. Hosted instance: inference.tiyuvta.ai 它主要面向代码场景，适合做 AI 编程助手、代码生成或自动修复。
whyItMatters: 最近仍在高频更新，仓库成熟度和社区基础都不错。
fitFor: 适合做推理服务、模型部署、性能优化的工程团队。
